notes: No Clarity link; the county Election Information page posts Electionware/Hart-style PDF reports per election, many duplicated on newtools.cira.state.tx.us. 2024 general: 'SUMMARY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS REPORT BY PRECINCT' (24 pages, 'Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 8:47 PM', Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 03:01:51 GMT = 9:01 PM CST). 2026 primary: 'Unofficial Summary Early Voting Results by Precinct' plus 'Unofficial Summary Election Day Voting Results by Precinct' (77 pages, 'Precinct Summary - 03/03/2026 9:43 PM', Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 04:02:52 GMT = 10:02 PM CST). 2026 runoff: on election night 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT EARLY VOTING UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' (early votes only, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 00:39:13 GMT = 7:39 PM CDT) and 'SUMMARY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' (county totals, 'Election Summary - 05/26/2026 7:27 PM', Last-Modified 02:02:58 GMT = 9:02 PM CDT); the page's 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' link points to the same county summary file; precinct numbers with election-day votes first appear in 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT OFFICIAL RESULTS' (Last-Modified Fri, 05 Jun 2026 17:34:05 GMT). Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin); it could confirm whether any other runoff precinct file existed on election night.
tag_rationale: The 2024 general and 2026 primary are both END (one election-night precinct report with election-day votes), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT; confidence med because both were settled by check 2 with printed run times and Last-Modified times on election night.
